title: SAEBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Sparse Autoencoders in Language Model Interpretability
reasoning: The paper focuses on interpretability benchmarking for sparse autoencoders (SAEs). While it includes evaluation metrics for unlearning (safety) and spurious correlation removal (fairness/bias), these are treated as technical metrics for feature disentanglement and concept isolation rather than a primary focus on benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
